common: Isometric three-quarter top-down cutaway view, cute miniature diorama look, clean soft shading, bright and airy. Absolutely no text, letters, numbers, signage, logos or watermarks. items.prompt: A bright white and pastel open-plan newsroom office seen as an isometric cutaway with no ceiling, large floor-to-ceiling windows with a soft city skyline. Distinct zones separated by low white partitions: a research corner with bookshelves and two desks, an editing and design area with four desks and monitors, a review desk with a big rubber stamp, a small glass recording booth with a microphone, an art studio corner with easels, a print room with a large printer and paper stacks, a video editing booth, a social media corner with phone stands and ring lights, a cozy lounge with a pastel sofa, a coffee bar and plants, and on the right side a separate sports room behind a glass partition with a big wall screen. The office is empty of people (characters will be added later). Pastel mint, blush pink, butter yellow and sky blue accents on white.

Same concept as a cozy white pastel newsroom office diorama: research library nook, editing desks cluster, review desk, recording booth, art corner, print room, video booth, social media corner, lounge with sofa and piano-free coffee bar, and a glass-walled sports room on the right with a big screen. Rounded furniture, light wood floor, many green plants, warm morning light. No people.
